subject: trying to use more than one cofactor in mqm

messages.author: 0d0d0c40322a789d
messages.subject: trying to use more than one cofactor in mqm
parts:
Hi All,

i am trying to use more than one cofactor using codes below. And i get " Error in if (max(cofactors) > n.mark) stop("Trying to set a non-existent marker as a cofactor.") : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed" this error.

maybe some can help me.

thanks alot

Yusuf

multitoset <- find.markerindex(multitrait_ch2nd, "60992576_7,55863428_7")   
setcofactors <- mqmsetcofactors(multitrait_ch2nd,cofactors=multitoset)  
mqm <- mqmscan(multitrait_ch2nd,cofactors=setcofactors)

messages.author: 92292fc48bf46044
messages.subject: Re: trying to use more than one cofactor in mqm
parts:
Hey Yusuf,

I cannot be sure, since I do not have your cross object,however it looks like your are forgetting to specify the marker names separately as a vector

Try changing the line:

To:
multitoset <- find.markerindex(multitrait_ch2nd, c("60992576_7", "55863428_7"))

And see if it works then.

Gr,
Danny
